note: Measured starboard hull sections of the GameModels3D pjsb010 viewing reference (B_Hull), assembled from three bun run ship:lines spans in one frame (--shift 2.2, --breaks none, --high 0.1,...,1): the stem to the forecastle break (reference z -114.8..-57.5), the casemate shelf (-57.5..12, --deck-below 3.72) and the upper deck to the stern (12..110.4). The forecastle deck of the first span follows the deck line cut at x = 2 m (ship:slice --section x=2); stations whose deck caught a barbette ring or windlass bed were re-levelled on their own outline. Runtime z = reference z + 2.2; station = 112.6 - z, from the stern (0) to the stem (length). Points [half-breadth, height] run from the keel on the centreline to the deck edge. Measurement only: no reference mesh is stored. The stations from 208.95 to the stem (runtime z -96.35 forward) were re-measured on `ship:slice pjsb010 --section z=...` cuts of the hull group to the true stem and forefoot, the lowest point of each cut (ship:lines takes the keel where the shell comes within 0.3 m of the centre line, which cut the stem back by up to 1.4 m), at the same levels and keeping each station's deck edge; the end station at the stem head starts at 7.71 m, as the reference's last cut does.
